title: Scanner Accuracy & Robustness Improvements for Online Datasets
summary: Improves card and grid scanner accuracy across diverse player screenshots, fixing lattice container resolution, downscaled star clustering, and equipment confidence calibration.

changes.text: Lattice Resolution: prevent multi-card grid lattices from being discarded by enclosing modal dialog containers.
Downscaled Star Clustering: increase star notch tolerance and HSV thresholds so 5-star cards retain 100% star detection on downscaled and blurred images.
Footer Snap Fallback: add footer snap fallback in guessGridKind to ensure weapon cards with slight bounding box offsets correctly identify grid kind.

Equipment Match Confidence: calibrate kind-aware peak block thresholds for 3D rendered weapons and equipment subject to bloom and particle effects, achieving 100% item identification accuracy across online datasets.
